# Skill 2 — Quote / Negotiation Response

A Claude Code **skill**. When a customer counter-offers on a diamond quote, recommends ACCEPT / COUNTER / HOLD / WALK_AWAY / ESCALATE and optionally drafts the reply message. Uses CLV tier, demand signals, and churn risk to calibrate discount headroom.

## Layout

```
skills/quote-negotiation/
├── SKILL.md                      # skill — frontmatter + instructions Claude reads
├── scripts/
│   └── quote_negotiation.py      # negotiation engine + CLI
├── install.sh                    # copies skill into .claude/skills/ to activate
└── README.qmd                    # this file
```

## Activate it

```bash
bash skills/quote-negotiation/install.sh
```

Restart Claude Code (or open a new session) to activate.

## Using it through Claude

> "How should we respond to CUST0013's counter-offer on QTE00042?"
> "Review all our negotiating quotes."
> "Should we accept $1,190 for this stone?"
> "Draft a reply to the customer's counter-offer."

## Running the script directly

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate

# Single quote
uv run python skills/quote-negotiation/scripts/quote_negotiation.py --quote QTE00001

# All negotiating quotes
uv run python skills/quote-negotiation/scripts/quote_negotiation.py --all-negotiating

# With LLM-drafted customer reply
uv run python skills/quote-negotiation/scripts/quote_negotiation.py \
    --all-negotiating --model api-llama-4-scout

# JSON output
uv run python skills/quote-negotiation/scripts/quote_negotiation.py --all-negotiating --json
```

## Decision rules

| Situation | Decision |
|---|---|
| Deal value > $50,000 | **ESCALATE** to senior manager |
| No customer counter yet | **HOLD** at current offer |
| Customer offer ≥ our ask | **ACCEPT** |
| Customer offer ≥ max concession (within CLV headroom) | **ACCEPT** |
| Customer offer ≥ floor price | **COUNTER** at max concession |
| Customer offer < floor price | **WALK_AWAY** |

### Discount headroom by CLV tier

| Tier | Headroom off current offer |
|---|---|
| Diamond | 5.0% |
| Gold | 3.0% |
| Silver | 1.5% |
| New | 0.5% |

Adjusted by: −1% for high-demand category, +1% for low-demand, +0.5% for high churn risk.

Floor price = `cost_basis × 1.08` (8% minimum margin).

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_quote_negotiation.py -v
```

26 tests covering `assess_quote`, `evaluate_negotiation`, `batch_negotiating`, `format_decision`, `format_batch`, and CLI.
